- Find the names of sailors who have reserved all boats called Interlake.

![list](262,368,697,388)
- Find the names of sailors who have reserved at least two different boats.

![formula](299,388,767,474) $$
R1 \times \text{Reserves} \\
R1.sid = \text{Reserves}.sid \text{ AND} \\
R1.bid \neq R2.bid
$$

![list](257,468,706,488)
- Find the names of sailors who have reserved the same boat at least twice.

![formula](218,490,717,601) $$
P(R1, \text{Reserves}) \\
T1 \leftarrow \pi_{\text{sid}}(R1 \times \text{Reserves}) \\
R1.sid = \text{Reserves}.sid \text{ AND} \\
R1.bid = \text{Reserves}.bid \text{ AND} \\
R1.day \neq \text{Reserves}.day
$$

![formula](260,607,718,698) $$
R \in \pi_{\text{name}}(T, \times \text{Sailors})
$$
